## :dart: Learning goals of this course
- Understand the concept of functions
- Implement functions

## Basic structure

- Who is not familiar with the concept of a function in programming?

```{.cpp}
<return_data_type> function_name( <input_1>, <input_2>,... ){
    // function body
    return <return_value>
```

## Call by value

-  What happens in memory? Let's check!

::::: {.column width="100%" .custom-box}
### Code file [`main_function_memory.cpp`](./code/main_function_memory.cpp)
```{.cpp include="./code/main_function_memory.cpp"}
```
```{python}
#| echo: false
%run ../../scripts/compile_and_run_cpp.py ./code/main_function_memory.cpp 
```
:::::

- Per default, the input is copied to a new location in memory.
- Advantage: Data is save from modification inside the function.
- Disadvantage?


## Call by reference

::::: {.column width="100%" .custom-box}
### Code file [`main_function_memory2p.cpp`](./code/main_function_memory2p.cpp)
```{.cpp include="./code/main_function_memory2p.cpp"}
```
```{python}
#| echo: false
%run ../../scripts/compile_and_run_cpp.py ./code/main_function_memory2p.cpp 
```
:::::

- Address of a is copied to a new location in memory.
- Data can be modified by dereferencing the pointer (output).
- Disadvantage?

## Call by reference C++ style

::::: {.column width="100%" .custom-box}
### Code file [`main_function_memory2.cpp`](./code/main_function_memory2.cpp)
```{.cpp include="./code/main_function_memory2.cpp"}
```
```{python}
#| echo: false
%run ../../scripts/compile_and_run_cpp.py ./code/main_function_memory2.cpp 
```
:::::

- `&` operator ensures data is not copied (pointers!)
- Disadvantage: Data is not save from modification inside function.
- Advantage: Data can be modified from within function, performance

## :trophy: Advanced Exercise

::: {.column width="100%" .custom-box}
### Solving an ordinary differential equation

- Rewrite your ODE solver as a function which takes start time and time grid as input and returns the solution at each time point as output. Use another function to define the right-hand-side of your ODE.

- Rewrite your ODE solver to take the initial condition as an argument.
:::

::: {.column width="100%" .custom-box}
### Memory management

Write a function which takes a dynamic array of type `double` called `x` as an input and an array `y` as output.
The function then stores $sin(x[i])$ in the output array.
Make sure that `x` is copied efficiently and cannot be modified inside the function. The output `y` should be available outside the function after it has been called.
:::
